# Facebook Posts Search

- This **Apify Actor** searches for posts on **Facebook** based on keywords or hashtags. The results include post url,
  post content, publication date,
  author information, and engagement metrics.


- It is a perfect tool for **monitoring** Facebook for **brand mentions** over time
  **Stay ahead** of potential reputation risks, respond to significant events, and engage with **highly active** public
  discussions 🚀

---------------

## Features

- 🔍 Search by **keywords, hashtags**
- 📅 Filter by **location**
- 📊 Extract **likes, comments, reactions, shares etc.**
- 🖼️ Retrieve **images and links** from posts

## Input Parameters

| Parameter      | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                                  |
|----------------|----------|----------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `query`        | `string` | ✅        | Keyword to search posts for.                                                                                 |
| `resultsCount` | `number` | ❌        | Maximum number of posts to extract (e.g. `30`).  If not set, only a few of the first posts will be returned. |
| `maxResults`  | `number` | ❌        | Alias for `resultsCount`; `resultsCount` takes precedence when both are provided.                            |
| `location`     | `string` | ❌        | Search posts with a pinned location. Accepts a name (e.g. `London`) or a Facebook Location ID.               |
| `searchType`   | `string` | ❌        | Search type: most popular - top (default) or latest. Defaults to platform’s default if not specified.        |
| `startDate`    | `string` | ❌        | Get posts starting from given date (YYYY-MM-DD).                                                             |
| `endDate`      | `string` | ❌        | Get posts ending on date (YYYY-MM-DD).                                                                       |

## Example Input

```json
{
    "query": "Orange",
    "resultsCount": 50,
    "searchType": "latest"
}
```

or

```json
{
    "query": "bronco",
    "resultsCount": 5,
    "startDate": "2025-01-01",
    "endDate": "2025-01-31"
}
```

## Output Data

The actor returns an array of JSON objects with extracted post data. When Facebook provides a location tagged in a
post, its ID is returned in the optional `taggedLocationId` field.

## Usage

1. **Create an Apify account** and navigate to the actor.
2. **Configure input parameters** in the Apify UI or via API.
3. **Run the actor** and monitor execution logs.
4. **Download extracted posts** as JSON, CSV, or Excel.

## Limitations & Notes

- Scraping Facebook data **must comply with their Terms of Service**.
- Avoid excessive scraping to prevent IP bans.
- Free users can retrieve up to **100 posts per search query**.
- Free users are rate-limited to a certain number of requests per day.
- For higher usage limits, upgrade to a [paid Apify plan](https://apify.com/pricing).

## Works Best With

To maximize the effectiveness of this scraper, use it in combination
with [Facebook Comments Scraper](https://apify.com/scraper_one/facebook-comments-scraper).

By first extracting Facebook posts with this scraper, you can then pass the collected post URLs into the Facebook
Comments Scraper, allowing you to retrieve
comments associated with those posts.

### Best Use Case Scenario

- 🔎 Run Facebook Posts Search actor → Collect a list of posts based on keywords.
- 📥 Feed post URLs into Facebook Comments Scraper → Extract comments from the collected posts for deeper analysis.
- 📊 Get full post insights → Combine post metadata and comments for a complete dataset.

This workflow is ideal for social media monitoring, sentiment analysis, and engagement tracking. 🚀

## Other Recommended Scrapers

If you're working with multiple platforms or want additional data sources, check out these scrapers:

- 🐦 [X (Twitter) Posts Search](https://apify.com/scraper_one/x-posts-search) — Find posts/tweets based on keywords,
  hashtags, and more
- 🐦 [X (Twitter) Post Replies Scraper](https://apify.com/scraper_one/x-post-replies-scraper) — Scrap replies of multiple
  X (Twitter) posts
- 🐦 [X (Twitter) Profile Posts Scraper](https://apify.com/scraper_one/x-profile-posts-scraper) — Scrap posts of specific
  X (Twitter) profile
- 📘 [Facebook Posts Search](https://apify.com/scraper_one/facebook-posts-search) — Discover Facebook posts for a given
  topic or page
- 📘 [Facebook Comments Scraper](https://apify.com/scraper_one/facebook-comments-scraper) — Extract comments from public
  Facebook posts
- 📘 [Facebook Reactions Scraper](https://apify.com/scraper_one/facebook-reactions-scraper) — Scrap reactions from
  Facebook posts (like, sad, haha, angry etc.)
- 📘 [Facebook Posts Scraper](https://apify.com/scraper_one/facebook-posts-scraper) — Scrap posts from Facebook pages,
  groups etc.
- 🎬 [YouTube Search Scraper](https://apify.com/scraper_one/youtube-search-scraper) — Extract videos from search queries
- 🎬 [YouTube Comments Scraper](https://apify.com/scraper_one/youtube-comments-scraper) — Extract comments from posted
  videos
- 🎬 [YouTube Downloader](https://apify.com/scraper_one/yt-downloader) — Download youtube videos

## Support & Contact

✉️ If you encounter issues or need help, feel free to **open an issue** or contact us at **scraper1one@gmail.com**

{
  "title": "Custom Search Input",
  "description": "Input schema for searching Facebook data using Apify Actor.",
  "type": "object",
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "properties": {
    "query": {
      "title": "Search Query",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "The search term to look for.",
      "editor": "textfield",
      "prefill": "Tesla",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 100,
      "pattern": "^[^{}$<>`]*$"
    },
    "resultsCount": {
      "title": "Number of results",
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Number of search results to retrieve. If not set, only a few of the first posts will be returned. Note: Free-plan users can retrieve up to 100 posts per search query.",
      "editor": "number",
      "minimum": 1,
      "prefill": 10
    },
    "maxResults": {
      "title": "Maximum results (alias)",
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Alias for resultsCount. Used only when resultsCount is not provided.",
      "editor": "number",
      "minimum": 1
    },
    "searchType": {
      "title": "Search Type",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "What kind of posts you'd like to search for. Defaults to platform’s default if not specified.",
      "editor": "select",
      "default": "top",
      "enum": [
        "top",
        "latest"
      ],
      "enumTitles": [
        "Most popular",
        "Latest"
      ]
    },
    "location": {
      "title": "Location",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Limit posts to a given **pinned** location. Enter a location name or a Facebook Location ID. For names, the first result from the Facebook location dropdown is selected. For example, entering 'Alaska' will result in 'Anchorage, Alaska'.",
      "editor": "textfield",
      "maxLength": 20
    },
    "startDate": {
      "title": "Start Date",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Get posts starting from given date (YYYY-MM-DD).",
      "editor": "datepicker",
      "pattern": "^(\\d{4})-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])$"
    },
    "endDate": {
      "title": "End Date",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Get posts ending on given date (YYYY-MM-DD).",
      "editor": "datepicker",
      "pattern": "^(\\d{4})-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])$"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "query"
  ]
}
